name: Ruriruri1
source:
A parody on Sega Saturn hit Kidou Senkan Nadesico: The Blank of 3 Years. Its heroine Hoshino Ruri will know lots of love and insult over these blank three years. The secret of energy transfer between main characters is given original explanation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
模仿世嘉土星的游戏《Kidou Senkan Nadesico: The Blank of 3 Years》。女主人公星野琉璃在这空白的三年里经历了很多爱和侮辱。主角之间能量传递的秘密得到了独到的解释。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
